q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in China. I listen to music every day, usually in the evening. When I’m listening to music, I often do my homework or tidy my room. Last month I went to my friend’s birthday party. We listened to pop music and danced together in her living room. It was really fun and everyone was very happy. I’ve lived in my town for ten years, since I was three. I use buses at the weekend, when I go to the shopping centre with my mum.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句细节或理由（例如听音乐时做什么、和朋友在哪里听了什么音乐、感觉怎样），用一般现在时说习惯、用一般过去时讲经历、用现在完成时说住了多久，句子简单正确、前后连贯。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like playing table tennis, but I think it’s quite difficult, because the ball is very fast. Watching football is exciting, especially when my favourite team scores a goal. I think playing computer games is fun, but you shouldn’t play for too long. Learning to play chess is interesting, because you have to think a lot. Playing basketball is good for you, because you run and jump a lot. I like basketball best, because I can play it with my friends after school. Yes, I enjoy playing games with my family. We often play card games at the weekend. I prefer playing outdoor games, because I like being in the fresh air.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图中的游戏和运动（乒乓球、看足球、电脑游戏、国际象棋、篮球）说出喜不喜欢以及原因，回应同伴的提问，回答考官的追问，说出最喜欢哪一种，并能谈是否喜欢和家人一起玩游戏、更喜欢室内还是户外游戏，用 because、but 等把理由说清楚。
